clusters.title: Typed free and presented calculus

assumptions: Lawful target calculi and correctly typed generator assignments are input data.
Presentation equations must be parallel.
proved_conclusions: Occurrence-linear substitution satisfies both units and associativity in actual prescribed profile fibres; recursive syntax is compared with independent planar incidence trees.
Free extension is universal among all strict maps, with both inverse maps, two-variable naturality and adjunction packaging.

Declared equations generate the least substitution congruence; its quotient is a calculus with universal descent. Derivability, quotient equality and equality in all models agree in the stated model universe.

clusters.title: Static positive rank versus persistent realization and the defect audit
clusters.theorem_scope: Exact stationary two-channel reflection processes; separately, same-state conditionally independent channel emissions in a finite hidden Markov realization.
assumptions: Reflection construction uses its explicit cone-preserving operators and rational rotation order q>=3 or irrational angle.
Defect bound requires both channel emissions at the same hidden state, before or after a common transition; not arbitrary edge/mixed-time emissions.
proved_conclusions: Reflection process is stationary and every finite observed word has positive probability; infinite past-future Hankel nonnegative rank is exactly 3, and each complete one-channel process has an edge-emitting realization with at most 3 states.

The joint minimal edge-emitting hidden-state count is exactly q for rational rotation order q, and no finite realization exists for irrational angle. Same-state independent-emission joint count is only bounded between q and 4q. No observed word is an exact reset.
For any fixed candidate budget K<q, a finite exact cylinder discrepancy occurs within the proved bound; this is not a statistical noisy-data test.

The hidden-mode defect bound K>=r+rank(F) is exactly the split-channel flattening rank bound K>=rank([T_ab]); invertible observable transition is needed only for the normalized defect formula. A globally minimal model with invertible full hidden transition has defect zero. Edge/mixed-time counterexamples invalidate those extensions.
not_established: Static nonnegative factorization is not shift-invariant positive dynamics; low marginal ranks do not reconstruct one small joint mechanism.
Neither reflection gap nor defect is an architecture discovery or positive-realization sufficiency theorem.
Classical positive-realization/invariant-cone and masking baselines explain the broad gap; no priority claim for it.
